review.verdict: 99 on six bosses, no deaths, and the decursing of someone who only decurses when it doesn't cost a Frostbolt
review.summary: Annoyingly clean: Lucifron, Gehennas, Geddon, Shazzrah, Golemagg and Ragnaros all 99, a 98 average, and you didn't die once, which after BWL the same evening is a personal record of its own. Majordomo 92 and Sulfuron 96 are personal bests. The weak spot is the job mages are actually in MC for.

good.title: Six 99s
good.text: Lucifron, Gehennas, Baron Geddon, Shazzrah, Golemagg and Ragnaros. Second highest damage in the raid on Geddon.

good.title: Alive
good.text: Zero deaths. After dying three times in BWL an hour earlier, worth writing down.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Supreme Power, Greater Arcane and Mageblood on all 10 boss pulls, 4.8 buffs a pull against 3.8 for the other DPS.

fix.title: Decursing
fix.text: 2 Gehennas' Curses removed while the median decurser did 4 and the best did 7, and 1 Shazzrah's Curse. Six 99 parses come a lot easier when somebody else spends their globals on Remove Curse.

fix.title: No Zanza
fix.text: Zanza on none of the 10 boss pulls.

50668.text: 99, second highest damage in the raid.

review.verdict: Golemagg 99, Ragnaros 98, and a Lucifron where a Flamewaker had more control over your character than you did
review.summary: Nine of ten bosses at 87 or better, Golemagg 99, Garr, Majordomo and Ragnaros 98, no deaths. Fine. But on Lucifron a Flamewaker Protector took your character for most of a 27 second fight and you parsed a clean 0, and then you spent Magmadar and Gehennas standing in fire like a cat that's never seen a stove.

good.title: Top-end parses
good.text: Golemagg 99, Garr 98, Majordomo 98, Ragnaros 98, Gehennas 97, Magmadar 95, Shazzrah 95.

good.title: No deaths
good.text: Zero deaths again; you usually die 1.6 times a raid.

good.title: Faerie Fire and an Innervate
good.text: 55 Faerie Fire (Feral) casts and an Innervate for a healer.

fix.title: Rain of Fire on Gehennas
fix.text: Two Rain of Fire ticks (1,878) when the raid's median was 1,166. It's a big red circle. It falls from the sky. Cats are supposed to have reflexes.

fix.title: Magmadar's fire
fix.text: 8 hits from Lava Bomb fire. Under the raid's median of 10, which says more about the raid than about you.

fix.title: Geddon and Sulfuron
fix.text: 88 and 87, ten points under your usual 98 on both.

fix.title: Food
fix.text: Well Fed on 3 of 10 boss pulls. 3 consumable buffs a pull against 3.8 for the other DPS. Molten Core on an empty stomach, bold.

50663.text: Mind-controlled by a Flamewaker Protector for most of the fight. 0 parse, and honestly the Protector played you better.
